blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) will deploy 19,869 police personnel to secure venues, hotels and motorcade routes during the Asean Summit on Nov. 15 to 17. The police force is also stepping up intelligence monitoring and finalizing its security preparations ahead of the regional gathering, which is expected to bring more than 20 world leaders to the country. “We will deploy 19,869 police personnel to secure the summit venues, hotels, and motorcade routes in close coordination with the Armed Forces of the Philippines, the Presidential Security Command, other agencies, and local government units,” PNP chief Gen.
